title: Armies & Control
text: Each player commands an army of Citadel miniatures. Friendly units belong to your army, enemy units to your opponent.

title: Active & Opposing Players
text: Turn-based sequencing shifts active and opposing roles dynamically depending on movement, shooting, or fighting phases.

title: Measuring Distances
text: Measured in inches (") to or from the closest part of a model’s base.

title: Dice Rolls
text: Uses six-sided dice (D6). Expressed as targets (2+), ranges (1-3), multiple dice (2D6), halved (D3), or modified values.

title: Leadership & Battle-Shock
text: 2D6 rolled against Leadership (Ld). Battle-shock occurs during the Command phase for units at or below half-strength. Effects: OC becomes ‘-’, ineligible for stratagems, cannot start/complete actions.

title: Move (M)
text: Speed traversal in inches (‘-’ means immovable).

title: Toughness (T)
text: Resilience metric against incoming damage.

title: Save (Sv) & Invulnerable Save (InSv)
text: Armor defense target (e.g., 4+) and unmodifiable field protection.

title: Wounds (W) & Leadership (Ld)
text: Damage health pool and morale threshold.

title: Objective Control (OC)
text: Holding metric for objective markers (‘-’ indicates zero control capacity).

title: Keywords
text: Capitalized faction and general tags (e.g., INFANTRY, ORKS).

title: Moving Units
text: Straight lines and/or pivots. Friendly models can be passed through, but enemy models and battlefield edges block movement.

title: Unit Coherency
text: Models must remain within 2" horizontally and 5" vertically of at least one other model, and within 9" horizontally and 5" vertically of every other model in multi-model units.

title: Engagement Range
text: The active close combat zone within 2" horizontally and 5" vertically of an enemy model.

title: Attack Sequence
text: Attacks follow a strict three-step sequence: Select Weapons → Select Targets → Resolve Attacks.

title: Hit Rolls
text: Roll one D6 per attack. Unmodified 1 fails, unmodified 6 is a Critical Hit, values meeting or exceeding BS/WS succeed.

title: Wound Rolls
text: Checked via Strength vs Toughness table. Unmodified 1 fails, unmodified 6 is a Critical Wound.

title: Save Rolls
text: Defender allocates wounds (damaged non-characters first, then undamaged non-characters, then characters) and rolls saves.

title: Inflict Damage
text: Failed saves reduce model wounds by the weapon’s Damage (D) characteristic. Mortal Wounds bypass normal/invulnerable saves sequentially.

title: Battle Rounds
text: Games consist of 5 battle rounds, alternating turns split into structured phases.

title: Command Phase
text: Gain 1 Core CP, make battle-shock tests, and resolve command rules.

title: Movement Phase
text: Remain Stationary, Normal Move, Advance (adds D6, bars charging/actions), and Fall-Back.

title: Shooting Phase
text: Select targets and resolve ranged attacks.

title: Charge Phase
text: Declare charges within 12", roll 2D6 distance, and move into engagement.

title: Fight Phase
text: Pile In (up to 3"), Fight (alternating activations prioritizing Fights First), and Consolidate (up to 3").

title: Terrain Categories
text: Exposed, Light (provides Benefit of Cover), Dense (blocks visibility), and Obscuring.

title: Benefit of Cover
text: Worsens incoming ranged attack BS characteristics by 1 if obscured or within cover.

title: Stratagems & Actions
text: Tactical tools activated via Command Points (CP) or specialized battlefield tasks.

title: Monsters & Vehicles
text: Can crush through models, measure from hulls, and shoot while engaged (-1 to hit).

title: Transports & Attached Units
text: Carry models with specific capacities; Leaders attach to Bodyguards to form single combined entities.

title: Reserves & Aircraft
text: Units deployed off-board can arrive via deep strike or strategic ingress.

title: Anti-X Y+
text: Scores critical wounds against specific keyword targets automatically on modified/unmodified thresholds.

title: Assault
text: Allows ranged shooting even after an Advance move.

title: Blast
text: Adds +1 attack per 5 models in target unit; unusable in engagement range.

title: Cleave
text: Specialized melee armor penetration enhancement.

title: Close-Quarters
text: Optimized for short-range firefights.

title: Deadly Demise (X)
text: Triggers explosions causing mortal wounds when destroyed.

title: Deep Strike
text: Sets up in reserves and arrives >9" away from enemies.

title: Devastating Wounds
text: Critical wounds inflict mortal wounds, bypassing saves.

title: Extra Attacks
text: Grants additional attacks with specific weapons.

title: Feel No Pain
text: Additional ignore-damage rolls for each point of loss.

title: Fights First
text: Prioritizes combat activation at the start of the Fight phase.

title: Firing Deck (X)
text: Allows embarked models to fire weapons from inside transports.

title: Hazardous
text: Risk of self-harm or destruction upon firing.

title: Heavy
text: +1 to hit if the unit Remained Stationary.

title: Hover
text: Modifies flight profiles and movement characteristics.

title: Ignores Cover
text: Negates enemy cover bonuses to armor saves.

title: Indirect Fire
text: Targets out-of-sight units with -1 hit penalty and cover grant.

title: Lance
text: +1 to wound after making a Charge move.

title: Lethal Hits
text: Critical hits automatically wound.

title: Melta (X)
text: Adds damage at half-range.

title: Pistol
text: Can be fired while locked in engagement range.

title: Precision
text: Allocates attacks directly to specific CHARACTER models.

title: Rapid Fire (X)
text: Grants extra attacks at half-range.

title: Sustained Hits (X)
text: Critical hits generate extra hit rolls.

title: Torrent
text: Automatically hits targets without rolling.

title: Twin-Linked
text: Re-roll failed wound rolls.

title: Infiltrators
text: Deploys outside standard zones before battle.

title: Leader
text: Attaches characters to bodyguard units.

title: Lone Operative
text: Prevents ranged targeting unless within 12".

title: Scouts (X)
text: Pre-game pre-battle move of X inches.
